name: Mundio Booking Button
author: calendrioapps

sections.description:
Mundio Booking Button lets visitors of your WordPress site book an appointment with you on Calendrio, a French online booking tool for independent professionals: clients pick a free slot 24/7 and the appointment lands in your agenda.

Three ways to show it, no code needed

  • Editor block “Mundio Booking”: drag it where you want, choose button, text link or calendar, the text, the colors and the service in the side panel.
  • Elementor widget “Mundio Booking” (when Elementor is installed), and the shortcode [calendrio] for every other page builder (Divi, WPBakery, Beaver Builder, Bricks, Oxygen, classic editor, widgets).
  • Floating button that stays visible while visitors scroll: exactly where you want it (a corner, or a side and a distance in pixels), the size you want, on the pages you want, hidden on phones if you wish, with your own CSS and HTML if you like. A live preview in the settings shows the result as you choose.

What visitors get

  • A “Book” button or link that opens your booking page in a new tab, or the booking calendar directly inside your page ([calendrio style="calendrier"]): visitors pick a slot without leaving your site.
  • One button per service: give the service number and it is already selected ([calendrio presta="12"]). The numbers are listed in the plugin’s Start tab.
  • Online payment (deposit or full), manual approval, waiting list, gift cards and all your Calendrio settings work as on your page. From the embedded calendar, the payment step opens in the full window.
  • A “Back to the website” link after booking.
  • 7 languages (French, English, Spanish, German, Portuguese, Turkish, Arabic): the button follows the language of your site, or the one you choose.

Privacy first

  • The button is drawn by a script included in the plugin: no code is downloaded from outside, and nothing is sent to calendrio.fr while a visitor only reads a page. calendrio.fr is reached when the visitor clicks the button, or when you choose to show the calendar in the page.
  • An optional “Powered by Calendrio” mention can be shown under the button. It is off by default.
  • A (free) Calendrio account is required: https://calendrio.fr/register.php

For developers: template function mundio_booking_button( array( 'style' => 'calendrier', 'presta' => '12' ) ), MundioBooking.init() for content inserted after page load, direct links and an iframe address for any site, and an API for appointments and free slots (all plans). Everything is listed in the plugin’s “Help & developers” tab.

Français : Mundio Booking Button ajoute un bouton « Réserver », un lien ou votre calendrier de réservation Calendrio directement dans votre site WordPress. Calendrio est un logiciel français de prise de rendez-vous en ligne pour les indépendants. Bloc dans l’éditeur, widget Elementor, code court [calendrio] pour les autres constructeurs de pages, bouton flottant sur toutes les pages, un bouton par prestation, 7 langues. Rien n’est envoyé à calendrio.fr tant qu’un visiteur ne fait que lire une page. La mention « Propulsé par Calendrio » n’apparaît que si vous cochez la case prévue (désactivée par défaut).

External service

The button is drawn by a script included in this plugin (assets/calendrio-bouton.js): no code is downloaded from outside, and nothing is requested from https://calendrio.fr while a visitor only reads a page showing the button. Clicking the button opens your booking page on https://calendrio.fr in a new tab. If you choose the calendar embedded in the page (style="calendrier"), the booking page of https://calendrio.fr is shown in a frame inside your page: calendrio.fr then receives the usual technical data of a web page (IP address, address of the page shown in the frame), and the appointment is booked on calendrio.fr. On the settings page and in the editor, the plugin reads the public status of your link (business name, list of services) from https://calendrio.fr/wp_statut.php, only once you have ticked the connection box. Legal notice: https://calendrio.fr/mentions-legales.php · Privacy: https://calendrio.fr/confidentialite.php
sections.installation:
1. Plugins > Add New, search “Mundio Booking”, Install then Activate (or upload the .zip file).
  2. Mundio Booking menu > Start: enter your Calendrio link (the word after ?pro=) and tick the connection box.
  3. In the editor, add the “Mundio Booking” block where you want it. Or add [calendrio] (button) / [calendrio style="calendrier"] (calendar) anywhere, or tick “Floating button” in the Display tab.
sections.faq:
Can the calendar appear inside my page instead of a new tab?

Yes: choose “Calendar in the page” in the block, or use [calendrio style="calendrier"]. The frame follows the height of its content. If a service requires online payment, the payment step opens in the full window (payment pages cannot be shown inside another site); without payment everything stays in your page.

Can I make one button per service?

Yes. Each service has a number, listed in the Start tab. Choose the service in the block, or add presta="12" to the shortcode. Several services: presta="12,15".

Does it work with Elementor, Divi, WPBakery…?

Yes. Elementor has a “Mundio Booking” widget. Every other page builder has a text or shortcode module: paste [calendrio] there.

Which languages?

French, English, Spanish, German, Portuguese, Turkish and Arabic. The button follows the language of your site by default; you can force one in the Display tab or per button (lang="en").

Is anything sent to calendrio.fr when someone visits my site?

No, not for the button or the link: the script is included in the plugin and calendrio.fr is only reached when the visitor clicks. The calendar embedded in the page is a page of calendrio.fr shown in a frame, so calendrio.fr sees the visit, like any website.

Does it work with caching plugins?

Yes: the button is plain HTML plus a small script, nothing depends on the visitor.
sections.changelog:
1.3.1

  • Display tab: the button text is always written in the field (“Book” in the language of the site) and a live preview shows the button, and the floating button on a mock screen, as you change the settings.
  • Floating button, total freedom: free position (side and distance in pixels, or a preset corner), free size (text, inner margin, corners in pixels), choice of pages (all, all except…, only…), hidden on phones, your own CSS and your own HTML content (icon, image…).
  • Free size also available for every button (tailletexte, marge, arrondi), css attribute and HTML content for the shortcode, same controls in the block and the Elementor widget.
  • Saving one tab no longer touches the settings of the other tab.

1.3.0

  • “Mundio Booking” block for the WordPress editor: button, text link or calendar in the page, with text, colors, shape, size, language and service in the side panel.
  • Calendar embedded in the page (style="calendrier"): visitors book without leaving your site; the frame follows the height of its content; the payment step opens in the full window.
  • One button per service (presta="12"), with the list of services and their numbers in the Start tab.
  • “Mundio Booking” widget for Elementor.
  • Nothing is requested from calendrio.fr while a visitor only reads a page: the default texts of the 7 languages are included in the plugin.
  • The button follows the language of your site by default.
  • “Back to the website” link after a booking without payment, too.
  • Template function mundio_booking_button(), MundioBooking.init() for dynamic content, [mundio_booking] as a second name of the shortcode, “Help & developers” tab.
  • French, Spanish, German, Portuguese, Turkish and Arabic translations included.
  • Fixed: the floating button option now says that the position is the one chosen above.

1.2.0

  • The “Powered by Calendrio” mention is now optional and off by default (Display tab).
  • Translations are provided through translate.wordpress.org.

1.1.0

  • The button script is now included in the plugin (nothing is loaded as code from another site).
  • Link check: shows the connected business name.
  • Display tab: button color, language, shape, size, text color and floating position (also available as shortcode attributes).
  • Menu in the left column with Start and Display tabs.
  • Consent box before any data is read from Calendrio; existing sites keep working.
  • Settings removed on uninstall.

1.0.0

  • First version: shortcode, floating button, settings page.
